thread:
maria_cs: Quick loop — during this week's health check BloomHealth (acct BH-17) is at ~85% of monthly token quota. Usage trend +20% WoW. Thinking we should offer a soft limit bump and a short note explaining options. Thoughts?

aj_solutions: +1 to proactive. Do we have a cost impact calc? If we offer bump, what is the threshold and who approves?

ops-bot: Metrics snapshot — 7d tokens: 1,120,450; projected month: 4.9M; current quota: 5.8M; avg gen latency: 220ms; error rate (5xx): 0.6% :bar_chart:

kevin_sre: If we bump, recommend adding temporary rate caps per route to protect latency. I can add a guard for 7 days. Need ticket in eng-oncall.

lina_support: I'll prep the customer-facing copy and highlight options: short-term bump, upgrade to Dedicated, or burst credits. Want to align on timing — we typically send 72h notice for billing changes.

sam_eng: Can we do an immediate soft bump (10%) w/ auto-expire in 14 days? That's low risk. Need config change: quota.adjust(BH-17, +10%, expires=14d)

maria_cs: Ok — propose: offer +10% temporary bump, mention upgrade path & monitoring. Draft below — tweaks welcome:

```Dear Alice (@BloomHealth),

Noticing healthy growth on your usage this month — congrats! Your account is at ~85% of your current monthly quota. To avoid throttling and keep latency steady, we can apply a short-term 10% quota increase that will auto-expire in 14 days. No action required if you'd like us to proceed; reply \"BUMP\" and we'll enable it. Alternatively, we can schedule a call to discuss Dedicated capacity if you expect sustained growth.

Best,
Maria (Success)
```

aj_solutions: Looks good, maybe mention monitoring and rollback plan. Add sentence: "We'll monitor throughput and error rates and can roll back if we detect any regression." :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: I'll create eng-oncall ticket and add temporary route guard. Tagging @sam_eng for the quota API change.

sam_eng: Filed ticket #ENG-8472 and queued a small change to the quota service. ETA 2 hours. Will post once live.

lina_support: I'll queue the email for sending once sam confirms. Also will add a note in the support playbook for follow-up in 7 days.

maria_cs: Assigning actions — sam_eng: implement bump (ENG-8472). kevin_sre: route guard and monitoring. lina_support: send comm & follow-up doc. aj_solutions: approve any commercial concessions if customer asks. I'll ping BloomHealth now. :rocket:

ops-bot: Change applied — quota.adjust(BH-17) +10% expires in 14d. change_id: ch_01F3Z7

maria_cs: Sent message to Alice: "We've applied a temporary +10% bump — monitor and let us know." Will update thread if they reply.

noah_cs_manager: Nice — capture this as a playbook note so we can reuse. Add short template to weekly check docs.

maria_cs: Added to weekly playbook: "soft bump +10% template" and linked doc: https://redwood.atlassian.org/Playbooks/soft-bump

BloomHealth (reply): Alice: Thanks, Maria. Please proceed with the bump. We'll monitor usage and reach out if this becomes permanent.

maria_cs: Noted — closing loop. Will check back in next weekly health sync. :white_check_mark:
